personalities.name: Aggressive
descriptions: Restless and quick to anger, the kind of person who settles every argument by winning it.
Carries themselves like a fighter, and looks at everyone as a possible opponent.
Impatient, loud, and utterly certain they will win.

personalities.name: Cautious
descriptions: Careful to the point of paranoia. Never goes anywhere without at least three ways out.
Quiet and watchful, and very hard to find when they don't want to be found.
Plans everything twice and trusts no one, least of all their own Servant.

personalities.name: Schemer
descriptions: Charming, smiling, and always three moves ahead. Prefers others do their fighting for them.
Collects secrets the way some people collect stamps.
Polite to everyone, and has a plan for how to get rid of each of them.

personalities.name: Honorable
descriptions: Proud and old-fashioned. Believes a war should have rules, and keeps them.
Fights openly and expects others to do the same. Despises tricks.
Stiff-backed and formal, with a strong sense of what a Master should be.

personalities.name: Reckless
descriptions: Treats the war like a game, and seems to be enjoying it far too much.
Young, wild, and convinced nothing bad can happen to them.
Takes every risk, and so far has got away with all of them.

master1.text: You learn that a Master is operating around {district}. Those who have seen them say: {description}

master2.text: You track {label} to their base in {district}: {base}. Their name is {name}.

master3.text: You piece together who {name} really is. Family: {family}. Age: {age}. From: {origin}. {personalityNote}

servant1.text: Witnesses describe the Servant serving {label} clearly enough: it is a {class}.

servant2.text: You get a good look at the {class} in action, and can judge exactly how strong it is.

servant3.text: You finally recognize the {class}: from its weapon, its words and its Noble Phantasm, it can only be {trueName}.

personalityNotes.aggressive: They are hungry for a fight.
personalityNotes.cautious: They will not leave their bounded field unless they have to.
personalityNotes.schemer: They prefer to let others do the fighting.
personalityNotes.honorable: They fight openly, and expect the same.
personalityNotes.reckless: They take risks no sane Master would.

clash.text: A massive explosion was reported in {district} last night. {detail}
Something tore up a street in {district} overnight. {detail}
People in {district} were woken by what sounded like thunder on a clear night. {detail}

clashDetailUnknown.text: Nobody who saw it can describe it clearly.

eliminated.text: By morning, word comes from the church: a Master has withdrawn from the war. {remaining} remain, counting you.

eliminatedKnown.text: From what you know, it was {who}.

alliance.text: Rumors say two of the other Masters have been seen together, and not fighting.

watched.text: Last night you felt someone watching your base. By the time you looked, they were gone.

ransacked.text: You come home to find your base broken into. Wards torn down, doors forced. Someone knows where you live.

allyIntel.text: A message from your ally {ally}: they have learned something they think you should know.

allyBetrays.text: Your ally {ally} has turned on you.

allianceEnds.text: Your alliance with {ally} has quietly fallen apart.
